title: Phone Slip: Channel 9 on the "1,200 Acres" Post

fields.message: Has a post from @FoothillsScannerFeed: "Coyote Draw fire 1,200 acres, Gulch Village being evacuated NOW, Kestrel Springs next #SawmillFire." It has 900 shares. She wants the current acreage and the evacuation zones. Is Gulch Village under an ORDER? Did the power shutoff start the fire? You can also email her at jokafor@channel9news.example.
fields.deadline: Needs answer by 3:00 for the 5 o'clock lead!

instructorNote: This tests whether the PIO quotes only what the Incident Commander has confirmed: about 420 acres at 14:30, per Chief Dwight Kowalski. The PIO should give the zone status that is actually on the board and never say "order" unless the Sheriff has issued one, and should say the cause is under investigation. Watch whether the PIO logs the scanner post in the rumor log, checks statuses with the Sheriff, fire, co-op and schools, and posts a correction within the hour (SENTCS 7; EOP 6).

citations.documentTitle: SOP-WF-01: Evacuation Notification, Traffic Control and Sheltering
citations.quote: The county never repeats a fire agency perimeter or acreage as its own; it quotes the Incident Commander and the time. The PIO keeps a rumor log; examples: "Kestrel Springs is burning" (not confirmed)

citations.documentTitle: Sawmill County Emergency Operations Plan, Annex W: Wildland-Urban Interface Fire
citations.headingPath: Sawmill County Emergency Operati… › 6. Public alerts
citations.quote: The county sends alerts by the Sawmill Ready app, text and voice call through the mass notification system ("SawmillAlert", about 17,000 contacts), Wireless Emergency Alerts through IPAWS for orders,
